definitions.gloss: going to America; traveling to the United States
definitions.explanation: The act of traveling to the United States. Used as both a noun and a suru verb. Part of a series of 渡～ compounds meaning 'to go to [country].'

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{渡米|とべい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to go to America next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{渡米|とべい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He went to America to study abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{渡米|とべい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とき、⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: When I went to America for the first time, I was surprised by the cultural differences.

notes:
A compound of {渡|と} (to cross over) and ⟦{米|べい}→米：28297_bei⟧ (America, from ⟦{米国|べいこく}→米国：19596_beikoku⟧). This pattern exists for other countries:

- {渡英|とえい} — going to England
- {渡仏|とふつ} — going to France
- {渡独|とどく} — going to Germany
- {渡欧|とおう} — going to Europe

These compounds are more concise and slightly more formal than saying ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧. They are commonly used in news, biographies, and formal writing.
